scope: Dated full-lockfile audit and scoped minimatch caller/static-asset qualification. Local evidence from modified source; not hosted or production release qualification.

source.algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted tracked apps/console paths, each followed by NUL and file bytes; all bytes match sourceRevision.
source.candidateChange: Only pnpm-workspace.yaml and pnpm-lock.yaml differ for this dependency change. Unrelated concurrent working changes are not qualified by the audit revision field.

scanPolicy.scope: Entire lockfiles, including development, optional and platform-specific packages; no target/severity filters or ignores; informational and yanked warnings retained.

minimatch.removalCondition: Use a maintained parent declaring patched minimatch; review the exact locked graph and callers, remove its override, and pass the full audit. Exact parent changes require requalification.

matcherComparison.pathConstruction: Insertion-ordered set: synthetic paths below, then git ls-files apps/console in output order, strip apps/console/ from each file and add it followed by each nonempty directory prefix.
matcherComparison.expectedDifferences: Only partial matching of '.' against **/node_modules/**, **/.svelte-kit/**, **/build/** and !**/build/** across the three option sets. v11 returns false for the positive patterns; negation follows flipNegate. Real child paths and complete matches are unchanged.
matcherComparison.boundedAmplification: new Minimatch('**/../a/b/'.repeat(12) + 'x', { optimizationLevel: 2, braceExpandMax: 1000 }) throws RangeError in 11.0.5.
matcherComparison.configHashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify of [console-relative linted file, effective rules, effective parserOptions] in ESLint output order. Before/after configurations and complete lint JSON were identical.

frontend.comparison: For the baseline, use source.revision and its baseline lock/workspace hashes. For the candidate, keep the same 197 console files and build identifier with the audit.inputs dependency files. make build-web measures and enforces both budgets. No frontend builds or tests were rerun solely for this documentation update.
warnings: Both static builds reported NO_COLOR ignored because FORCE_COLOR was set; not suppressed.
